notes.title: Long Barrow is out now.
notes.content:
[h2][b]Long Barrow[/b][/h2]
Four to be laid to rest. Take them to the long barrow and find a spot inside for each one. Get it done quick before the sun goes down, the dead don’t like to be disturbed at night. And be wary of speaking to the dead, they may answer you back.
[list]
[*] Playtime - 15 Minutes | Endings - 1 | Collectables - 1
[*] First Person - Dialogue - Comedy
[/list]
[h3][b]Improvements and Fixes[/b][/h3]
[b]The Mall[/b]
opening staff only room before talking to The Owner skips first visit dialogue
outside houses now have numbers

[b]Out Of Gas[/b]
Replaced street light with new version
Shortened time for endings Forest and Backwards

[b]Nightmare[/b]
Can no longer interact with mirrors after first interaction
Doors in last section no longer make sound
Door frames in last section no longer have default walk sound play

[b]The Mine[/b]
Developer commentary "Mining System" added missing audio and subtitles
Developer Commentary no longer covered by UI
Can now interact with objects without swinging pickaxe

[b]M.A.D [/b]
Segment displays now use nearest neighbour texture filtering
No longer possible to select same target multiple times
Invalid Target Selection now only appears after selecting three targets or hitting backspace on the third target
Added abort launch button and removed switching off console
Mute alarm now lowers the volume instead of muting
Updated developer commentary on "Refuse Launch" to reflect update
Changed description text for difficulty to be more informative

[b]Warehouse 14[/b]
Replaced old utility poles with new physics based ones

[b]Santa's Workshop[/b]
Doors swapped to better version
Now has a collectable
Cartridge Menu improved background scene
endless mode is now endless
When endless mode enabled other options disabled

[b]Eternal Storage [/b]
Furnace will still play sounds when player not present

[b]Developer Commentary[/b]
Now pauses when game paused
Now has floating text to show name and number of the commentary and shows if played

[b]Cheat System[/b]
Added missing cheat options for Resolve Your Fate
New cheat options
Cheat Menu can now adjust player scale
Cheat menu style better matches rest of game

[b]Misc[/b]
New method for billboards, Improved lighting and works better
Cartridge Guides now available through In-game pause menu
Cartridge Guides improved with added information
Gallery UI improved and cartridge names added to full screen view
Main Menu Mall now fits the main game and updates to reflect main game
Player now holds all lights in left hand
In-game Pause Menu now shows cartridge progression percentage
Focusing light now changes how far light reaches
Dialogue speed now faster

notes.title: Resolve Your Fate is out now
notes.content:
Resolve Your Fate is out now. You can access it from free play or find it in The Mall.
 
[b]Fixes[/b]
Spelling mistakes
Font not updating in parts of menus

[b]Improvements[/b]
Added graffiti to Warehouse 14
Better icons for controller Dpad inputs
Ceiling of the mall now at correct pixel density
Added more to The Mall
Improved Streets for The Mall
Added improved cigarette models to Eternal Storage
Improved door sound effects
Added more assets to Eternal Storage
Added new subtitle system for developer commentary
Added new subtitle system
Game logos now show in cartridge information and title screen
New main menu buttons for social media
All translations have been redone through DeepL which should provide more accurate translations
Achievement unlocked sound replaced with new version
Updated cartridge stats and playtime based on analytics

notes.title: V2.6.0
notes.content: Fixed the console not being visible in The Mall

notes.title: V2.4.0 - Patch
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]
Cartridge unlocks screen for Santa's Workshop, document 2 now has correct name
Final checkpoint for Nightmare will now activate once you enter the Jack in the box room to stop softlock if you are killed
Strange paintings in Eternal Storage now display correct texture when picked up
Spelling mistakes in Eternal Storage
Picking up Warehouse 14 in The Mall will no longer cause M.A.D to appear on the shelf as well
Navigation flag colour now only affects the fabric
Zombies in The Mine will now get knocked away from the player if you hit them from behind instead of towards the player

[b]Improvements[/b]
New give feedback button that links to Google Forms where you can give feedback on each cartridge
Almost doubled amount of fuel lantern has in The Mine to encourage its use
Removed some paths and shorted others in The Mine to improve experience
Hallway doors in Eternal Storage have been moved and reworked so you cannot get lost as easily as before (Sorry to all the YouTube/Twitch players who spent so much time getting lost)
Footstep sounds closer together and come from in front of you now
When you pickup a cartridge and take it to the play area in The Mall the box will now automatically move to the shelf without needing to insert the cartridge into the console
Added secondary text for interaction text, important text will no longer disappear if you interact with something else
Added warning text that progress within cartridges is not saved
Navigation flags in The Mine now have numbers on them so you can more easily tell if you are going backwards
Zombies in The Mine now move faster, attack faster and are harder to kill
Player crouches slightly lower in The Mine now
Added dead zombie to crouch section of The Mine
Increased average playtime amount for Eternal Storage from 25 minutes to 35 minutes
You can now use the controller in The Mall

notes.title: V2.3.0 - Patch
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]
Removed Z-fighting wood block on the bridge in The Mine
Replaced default benchmark image with game related image
Pause menu Eject cartridge & Leave The Mall text now displays correctly
Placed missing wood floor tiles at exit of The Mall
Swapped box placement of Warehouse 14 & M.A.D to be in correct order
Console should no longer become softlocked after use in The Mall
Replaced missing ceiling in Nightmare
Can no longer trigger Refuse and Out Of Time endings at the same time in M.A.D
Removed interaction function from panels in M.A.D
Spelling mistakes in Eternal Storage removed
Silhouette event in Eternal Storage should not trigger whilst inside unit
Wrench will be hidden when picking up Flashlight in Eternal Storage
Disturbing content warning text rapidly changing scale should no longer happen
Placeholder text on box for Warehouse 14 swapped out
Back of box for Santa's Workshop updated to match better
Floating labels won't appear after placing and removing box from shelves in Santa's Workshop

[b]Improvements[/b]
Updated Analytics data
Game settings changed Headbob to Headbob intensity
Added another trigger for Doris events in Eternal Storage
Moved location of a key in The Mall to a better spot
The owners eyes will now glow in the dark
Buttons on cartridge information screen have clearer icon
Removed last digit from transmitted code in M.A.D to prevent confusion
Can now trade money for ring in Eternal Storage
Cartridge stats & info page now updates correctly and displays stats for different cartridges
Global stats now shows number of copies of the game sold instead of downloads

notes.title: V2.1.0 - Patch
notes.content:
The first patch for the game is out now with lots of bug fixes and improvements.

[b]Fixes[/b]
Default collectable being in Santa's Workshop
Ending screen eject cartridge not taking player back to The Mall
Missing stats for Eternal Storage
Missing stats for Santa’s Workshop
Music for Eternal Storage not playing if skipped intro
Replaced missing pipes in M.A.D
Replaced missing ceiling mesh in Nightmare
Santa's Workshop should now work on the TV in The Mall
Added checkpoint to Out Of Gas for point where pickup gas can
Dialogue window appearing multiple times when speaking to taxi driver in Out Of Gas
Removed duplicate sign for Unit 51 in Eternal Storage
Silhouette event in Eternal Storage triggering whilst you are in the unit
Shutter door event in Eternal Storage now closes at correct speed
Removed floating lights from The Mall
Dialogue options appearing after selecting option
Removed duplicate warehouses 5 & 6 from Warehouse 14

[b]Improvements[/b]
The Mall now has some wood flooring and a new switch (Do not press)
Cartridge Information screen looks better when in The Mall and has improved buttons
The maps in Eternal Storage now have indicators for where you are
Clearer instructions and guidance in M.A.D
